package.json Generator

Fill in name, version, scripts, and dependencies to get a valid, ready-to-use package.json.

📖 How to use

  1. Fill in the package name, version, and details.
  2. Add npm scripts and dependencies.
  3. Click Generate — copy or download package.json.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the output valid JSON?

Yes — the output is validated as JSON before it is shown, so it always parses.

Which fields are supported?

Name, version, description, main entry, license, module type, npm scripts, dependencies, and devDependencies.

How do I add devDependencies?

Tick the “dev” box on a dependency row to place it under devDependencies.

Can I download the file?

Yes — copy it or download it as package.json.
